import collections,json,re
from pathlib import Path
from legal_skill_guard.learning.experiment import read,sha,now
from legal_skill_guard.inference.codex_cli_client import render_structured_codex_prompt,CODEX_TURN_INPUT_CHARACTER_LIMIT
from legal_skill_guard.utils.hashing import canonical_json_sha256 as csha
from legal_skill_guard.experiment.storage import RunStore
root=Path.cwd();run=root/"runs/legal_openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03"
cfg=read(root/"configs/openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03.json")
calls=[];event_types=collections.Counter();item_types=collections.Counter();threads=[];warnings=[]
reasoning_occurrences=[];raw_cache={};members={}
for folder in sorted((run/"teacher").iterdir()):
 if not (folder/"response.json").exists():continue
 paths=[folder/n for n in ("wire_request.json","response.json","event_log.json")]
 wire,response,cap=map(read,paths)
 assert wire["model"]==response["model"]=="gpt-5.6-sol" and response["cache_hit"] is False
 assert [wire[k] for k in ("context_window_tokens","auto_compact_token_limit","max_input_tokens")]==[872000,800000,680000]
 assert cap["returncode"]==response["invocation"]["returncode"]==0
 assert csha({"event_log":cap["event_log"]})==response["invocation"]["event_log_sha256"]
 events=[];nonjson=[]
 for line in cap["event_log"].splitlines():
  try:e=json.loads(line)
  except json.JSONDecodeError:nonjson.append(line);continue
  if not isinstance(e,dict):continue
  events.append(e);event_types[e.get("type")]+=1
  if e.get("type")=="thread.started":threads.append(e["thread_id"])
  if isinstance(e.get("item"),dict):item_types[e["item"].get("type")]+=1
 completed=[e for e in events if e.get("type")=="turn.completed"]
 assert len(completed)==1
 usage={k:int(completed[0]["usage"].get(k) or 0) for k in ("input_tokens","cached_input_tokens","output_tokens","reasoning_output_tokens")}
 assert usage==response["invocation"]["usage"] and usage["input_tokens"]<wire["auto_compact_token_limit"]
 for line in nonjson:
  assert "failed to refresh available models: request timed out" in line,line[:80]
  warnings.append({"role":folder.name,"kind":"available-model-catalog refresh timed out; structured teacher turn still completed","line":line})
 body=json.loads(wire["user_prompt"])
 for case in body["already_seen_training"]:
  emitted=case["actual_parent_answer"]["source_model_emitted_evidence"]
  path=emitted["raw_call_path"]
  if path not in raw_cache:
   raw=read(root/path);text=raw["calls"][0]["response"]["choices"][0]["message"].get("reasoning_content") or ""
   raw_cache[path]={"characters":len(text),"tail":text[-1024:],"sha":csha(text),"source_sha256":sha(root/path)}
  observed=raw_cache[path];reason=emitted["reasoning"]
  assert reason["text"]==observed["tail"] and reason["characters"]==observed["characters"] and reason["canonical_text_sha256"]==observed["sha"]
  assert reason["truncated_to_tail"]==(observed["characters"]>1024)
  reasoning_occurrences.append({"role":folder.name,"raw_origin":path,"characters":observed["characters"],"explicit_tail_clipped":observed["characters"]>1024})
 chars=len(render_structured_codex_prompt(wire["system_prompt"],wire["user_prompt"]))
 assert chars<=CODEX_TURN_INPUT_CHARACTER_LIMIT
 calls.append({"role":folder.name,"usage":usage,"fresh_thread_and_single_completed_turn":True,"rendered_prompt_characters":chars,
  "configured_context_and_compaction_not_measured_remote_max":[872000,800000],"configured_input_guard":680000,
  "no_compaction_truncation_failure_or_tool_event_types":True})
 members.update({str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p) for p in paths})
assert len(calls)==len(threads)==len(set(threads))==15
assert set(event_types)=={"thread.started","turn.started","item.completed","turn.completed"} and set(item_types)=={"agent_message"}
for name in ("legal_skill_guard/inference/codex_cli_client.py","legal_skill_guard/learning/experiment.py",
 "experiments/openexempt_online.py","configs/openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03.json",
 "configs/openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03.frozen.json"):
 members[name]=sha(root/name)
out={"at":now(),"classification":"Actual15 saved teacher CLI invocations distinguish transport/context compaction from explicit bounded student-reasoning evidence; no new call or performance claim",
 "fresh_teacher_threads":15,"single_completed_turns":15,"unique_thread_IDs_not_disclosed":True,
 "event_types":dict(event_types),"item_types":dict(item_types),
 "actual_input_token_range":[min(c["usage"]["input_tokens"] for c in calls),max(c["usage"]["input_tokens"] for c in calls)],
 "actual_total_usage":{k:sum(c["usage"][k] for c in calls) for k in calls[0]["usage"]},
 "configured_thresholds":{"context_window":872000,"auto_compact":800000,"local_input_guard":680000,"character_guard":CODEX_TURN_INPUT_CHARACTER_LIMIT},
 "no_client_drop_or_truncate_to_fit_input":True,"no_logged_automatic_compaction_or_context_failure":True,
 "does_not_claim_to_inspect_provider_internal_behavior_or_supported_remote_max_context":True,
 "catalog_refresh_warnings_nonfatal":warnings,
 "explicit_parent_reasoning_tail_contract":{"max_characters":1024,"parent_view_occurrences":len(reasoning_occurrences),
  "occurrences_with_tail_clipping":sum(v["explicit_tail_clipped"] for v in reasoning_occurrences),
  "unique_actual_student_raw_origins":len(raw_cache),
  "unique_raw_origins_with_clipping":sum(v["characters"]>1024 for v in raw_cache.values()),
  "all_saved_tails_and_full_text_digests_match_original_raw":True,
  "not_equivalent_to_full_reasoning_trajectory_delivery":True,
  "failed_native_final_head_tail_contract_characters":512,
  "not_proof_that_clipping_caused_poor_learning":True},
 "official_configuration_definition_source":{"url":"https://developers.openai.com/codex/config-reference/",
  "actually_fetched_20261023":True,"scope":"Official docs define the context-window setting and the automatic-history-compaction threshold separately. They do not establish this experiment's private backend internals or maximum supported context."},
 "calls":calls,"student_raw_source_hashes_reference_existing_full_terminal_archives":{p:v["source_sha256"] for p,v in raw_cache.items()},
 "evidence_sha256":members,"no_model_teacher_tokenizer_TEST_or_source_changes":True,
 "recomputation_program":PROGRAM}
dest=root/"artifacts/research/openexempt_legal_scope_20261020/Run03_actual15_teacher_context_no_logged_compaction_vs_explicit1024_tail_delivery_NOT_quality_cause_20261023.json"
RunStore.immutable_json(dest,out)

 "event_types":dict(event_types),"explicit_reasoning_tail":out["explicit_parent_reasoning_tail_contract"],
